### `U-06` — Delegation of Pipeline Supervision-Evidence Review to Gemini CLI

- **Source locator**: Current user request to delegate supervision-evidence work to Gemini.
- **Plain-English explanation**: Delegates the completion of the supervision-evidence review and documentation to Gemini CLI.
- **Engineering rationale**: Produces an explicit, attributable technical review by Gemini CLI covering all 24 requirement classifications, the three architecture candidates (`3.10`, `4.65`, `3.10`), the five responsibility scopes, and lifecycle evidence status.
- **Resulting artifacts**: [`gemini-pipeline-review.json`](gemini-pipeline-review.json), [`../docs/process/pipeline-review.md`](../docs/process/pipeline-review.md)

### U-07 — Four-person team allocation

- **Source locator** — User message changing the team size after the request to document member supervision.

- **Decision and rationale** — The user reduced the team to four and reassigned the fifth role's duties so that release, report and verification work each retained an owner.
- **Result** — The revised responsibility table assigns report integration to Alfa, release governance to Bravo, reproducible delivery to Charlie and CI to Delta. [Team responsibilities](../docs/process/team.md)
", "supervision": "# Supervised development evidence

This index connects project decisions, five complete OpenCode sessions and the independent release review. It links each record to its scope and outcome.

## Direct team decisions and review

| Evidence | Decision and reason | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| [Project scope and release review](leo-project-directions.md#u-01--working-aliases-video-scope-exclusion-and-gemini-cli-assessment) (U-01) | The student directed the team to complete the reviewed non-video scope and obtain a separate technical assessment. | [Revision authorization](../docs/process/revision-authorization.md) and [ADR-004](../docs/architecture/adr/004-release-quality-and-context-budget.md) define the resulting work. |
| [Repository visibility](leo-project-directions.md#u-03--public-repository-visibility-and-history-publication) (U-03) | The student authorized publishing the project repository and history after the private repository blocked hosted checks and branch protection. | The repository became public. [Recorded branch policy](../evaluation/github/branch-protection-current.json). |
| [Recordkeeping and technical review](leo-project-directions.md#u-05--source-linked-intervention-annotations-clear-prose-and-re-review) (U-04 through U-06) | The student asked for concise commit messages, source-linked annotations and a Gemini review of the existing work. | The [intervention index](intervention-index.json) links original prompts to outcomes. The [technical review](../docs/process/pipeline-review.md) evaluates requirements and architecture after implementation. |
| [Four-person allocation](leo-project-directions.md#u-07--four-person-team-allocation) (U-07) | The student changed the team to four and directed redistribution of the former fifth role's work. | The [responsibility and review table](../docs/process/team.md) records the four areas. |
| [Delta's release approval](https://github.com/Fighterforever/cs5351-tradingagents-research-desk/pull/1#pullrequestreview-5840085663) (R-01) | Chengru WANG (`wangsaorui`) reviewed PR #1. The review memo records the gate and architecture checks, limitations of the inspection and the Python version coverage finding. | The reviewer approved PR #1, the PR merged, and all six [main-branch CI checks](https://github.com/Fighterforever/cs5351-tradingagents-research-desk/actions/runs/42798475065) passed. [Review memo](../docs/review-memo.md#independent-code-owner-review-of-pr-1). |

The [directives appendix](leo-project-directions.md) identifies the student who issued the recorded project directions. Delta's approval also has a [saved GitHub receipt](../evaluation/github/pr-1-release.json).

## Five annotated native sessions

Each row pairs a complete OpenCode export with its annotations. The coordinating workflow supplied the implementation instructions under the delegated project scope. The [message index](intervention-index.json) gives the session ID, message ID and exact position of each quoted instruction. Annota", "contributions": "

The [OpenCode implementation directives](transcripts/supervision-index.md) record instructions sent by the coordinating workflow.

| Working name | Work linked to the member |
|---|---|
| Alfa | The project plan assigns this area to Alfa. Individual work awaits confirmation. |
| Bravo | The project plan assigns this area to Bravo. Individual work awaits confirmation. |
| Charlie | The team assigned the account nicolas393 to this scope. Work attributable to the account awaits confirmation. |
| Delta | Submitted the independent [PR #1 review and approval](https://github.com/Fighterforever/cs5351-tradingagents-research-desk/pull/1#pullrequestreview-5840085663). Added an advisory Python version matrix and a supervision write-up in [PR #2](https://github.com/Fighterforever/cs5351-tradingagents-research-desk/pull/2), which remains open. |

The advisory matrix passed on Python 3.12 and 3.13. Installation stopped on 3.10 and 3.11. The [archived write-up](transcripts/60254685-Chengru-WANG.md) records Delta’s decisions on the PR branch. Its original Qoder conversation is held in the member’s client.
